pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos in a Tactical Vest Holding a Pistol Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos stands in an open garage with a pistol held beside her shoulder, wearing a pouch-covered tactical vest in this printable coloring page. Her ripped jeans and sneakers appear in front of parked cars, while a tool board, palm trees and scattered items fill the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dre'Quan Priest Holding a Phone Coloring Page
pages.description: Dre'Quan Priest sits with one hand resting on his knee and a phone held flat beside his mouth in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Thin braids frame his face above stud earrings and a thick chain, while tattoos, a wristwatch and ripped jeans add smaller details.

pages.title: GTA 6 Real Dimez Roxy and Bae-Luxe Posing Coloring Page
pages.description: Roxy and Bae-Luxe pose together with raised hands in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, framed by palm trees and distant city buildings. Roxy wears a fuzzy coat over a leopard-patterned top and shows her tongue, while Bae-Luxe has braided buns, hoop earrings, a striped top and fishnet beneath ripped jeans.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Crouching with a Shotgun by the Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval crouches with one palm on the ground and a shotgun pointing downward in this printable coloring page, beside a palm-lined waterfront skyline. His tank top, ripped trousers and lace-up sneakers fill the foreground, with a loose shell below the barrel and palms and a yacht across the water.

pages.title: GTA 6 VI Logo with Palm Leaves Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: The large VI emblem contains palm silhouettes in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with overlapping fronds extending inward from two opposite corners. Thick double outlines frame the Roman numerals, while the leafy shapes inside repeat the pointed leaves along the upper right and lower left edges.

pages.title: GTA 6 Platform Sandals Beside a Vertical Pole Coloring Page
pages.description: A close view of strappy platform sandals fills this printable coloring page inspired by GTA 6, with tall heels, thick soles, and bare toes beside a vertical pole. A buckled strap curves across one ankle, and the overlapping shoes create broad curved shapes against the otherwise empty background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos with a Raised Pistol Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos stand close together beneath palm fronds in this printable coloring page, with Lucia holding a pistol beside Jason's shoulder. Her high ponytail, hoop earrings and chain bracelet appear beside his short hair, beard, necklace and tank top, with two birds in the open sky.

pages.title: Jason Duval in a Tank Top with a Chain Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval from GTA 6 faces forward in this printable coloring page, wearing a tank top and a chain necklace against a backdrop of palm fronds. His short swept hair rises above the rectangular border, and a trimmed beard frames his face. Part of an arm tattoo is visible in the lower right corner.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos with a Flute Glass and Palm Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos holds a narrow flute glass in this printable coloring page, her straight bob framed by palm trees and tall buildings. Her belted dress has a deep V neckline and long sleeves, while layered pendant necklaces and a small beauty mark complete the portrait.

pages.title: Woman Holding a Drink and Lifting Sunglasses Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman raises one hand toward the sunglasses on her head in this printable coloring page, holding a can with a straw beside a swimming pool. Her cropped number six jersey, hoop earrings, bracelets, and layered necklaces fill the foreground. Long curls, palm fronds, lounge chairs, and rippling water add smaller sections around her pose.

pages.title: Female Jax Holding a Drink and Lifting Sunglasses Coloring Page
pages.description: A female version of Jax lifts her sunglasses in this printable coloring page, with long rabbit ears above her hair and a drink in her other hand. A Circus pendant hangs from a beaded necklace over her cropped number three shirt. Her shorts sit open over a side-tied bikini bottom, with bracelets and a dangling heart charm completing the outfit.

pages.title: Rosalina Holding a Drink with Star Sunglasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Rosalina raises one hand to her star-shaped sunglasses in this printable coloring page, holding a labeled energy drink can against a backdrop of palm trees. Her sweeping fringe covers one eye, and a flower sits beside the glasses. Hoop earrings, a star choker, and a cropped number eleven jersey distinguish her outfit.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Opening a Bottle Beside a Pickup Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval turns the cap of a bottle beside a pickup in this printable coloring page, wearing a tank top that leaves his upper-arm tattoo visible. Three round lights rise above the truck's cab, while palms surround a raised house with a long balcony. His chain necklace, stubble, and the bottle label add smaller details.

pages.title: Woman Wearing a Bandana and Cropped Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman faces forward with a paisley bandana covering her nose and mouth in this printable coloring page, her hair gathered into a high ponytail. Two loose strands frame her eyes above the patterned fabric. Large Baddie lettering spans her cropped hoodie, with drawstrings, sleeve folds, and a jeans waistband below.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Standing Beneath Palms Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia stand side by side beneath tall palm trees in this printable coloring page, wearing casual outfits with lace-up sneakers and jeans. His shirt has a small swoosh, and the knees of his jeans are torn. Her buttoned corset top, chain-strap handbag, hoop earrings, and bracelets create contrasting details.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Holding a Pistol and Duffel Bag Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia holds a pistol pointed downward in this printable coloring page, with a large duffel over her shoulder and a waterfront skyline behind her. A helicopter appears above the buildings, and a sports car fills the lower background. Her ponytail, hoop earrings, cheek mole, tank top, and cargo pockets provide clear details.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Holding an Iguana and Dog Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason holds a large iguana while Lucia cradles a small dog in this printable coloring page, with water and tall buildings behind them. Palm trees repeat across his open shirt and the covering around the iguana. Lucia closes her eyes beside the dog's pointed ears, while the iguana's scales and spiny back add fine details.

pages.title: Woman in a Dotted Dress with Flowing Hair Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman poses with one hand raised in this printable coloring page, wearing a fitted dress covered in small circles as her wavy hair spreads outward. Seated figures hold cups around low tables behind her, beneath draped fabric and ceiling lights. Rectangular confetti shapes scatter across the floor and through the air.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Eating Burgers Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia bite into large burgers in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with sesame seed buns and a tray of fries between them. Lucia wears hoop earrings and a high ponytail, while Jason has a palm patterned shirt over his T-shirt.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Holding a Rifle on a Car Hood Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason sits on a car hood holding a rifle in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with one knee raised above the round headlights. Torn shorts, a plain T-shirt, and a lace-up high top sneaker frame the diagonally held weapon. Low mountains and scattered shrubs stretch behind the car, leaving a wide open sky above his short hair.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos in a Cartoon Print Jersey Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia stands with her arms crossed in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, wearing a V-neck jersey with a large cartoon graphic across the front. Her high ponytail, hoop earrings, long nails, and wristwatch stand out above a belt and shorts. Palm trees, stepped building facades, street traffic, and cafe umbrellas fill the background around her.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Crouching and Aiming a Pistol Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia crouches low and points a pistol toward the viewer in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, bracing her other hand against the ground. A high ponytail, hoop earrings, ribbed tank top, and frayed shorts frame her pose. Laced sneakers fill the foreground, while palm trees, tall buildings, and a small car stand behind her.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia in a Long Dress Beside Jason Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia stand side by side in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with Lucia holding a pistol down beside her long fitted dress. She wears dangling earrings, bangles, strappy heels, and a quilted shoulder bag. Jason wears sunglasses, an open-collared shirt, a chain necklace, jeans, and sneakers beneath the palm trees.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Taking a Selfie in Camo Pants Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia holds up a phone for a selfie in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, resting her free hand on her hip above camouflage pants. Hoop earrings and a small heart pendant sit beneath her long ponytail, and a cropped T-shirt leaves broad open sections. Cars, pedestrians, palm trees, and a striped crosswalk line the street around her.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia with Guns in a Convertible Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia sit armed in a convertible in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with Lucia holding a pistol across her lap in front. Jason raises another pistol and holds a phone, while a bag of banknotes rests behind the seat. Lucia's patterned neck bandana and hoop earrings frame her face against the waterfront skyline, bridge, and Ferris wheel.

pages.title: GTA 6 Raul Bautista Adjusting a Glove Coloring Page
pages.description: Raul Bautista adjusts a glove at his wrist in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, wearing glasses, hoop earrings, and a suit over an open-collared shirt. A large zipped duffel hangs from a stitched shoulder strap beside his jacket. Buttons, a wristwatch, and a small necklace provide finer details, with utility wires, an arched structure, and a mask mural behind him.

pages.title: Woman in a Cropped Biker Jacket by a Convertible Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman poses with both hands in her pockets in this printable coloring page, wearing a cropped biker jacket beside an open convertible. Loose waves frame her hoop earrings and round pendant, while wide cuffs finish her pants above laced high top sneakers. Palm trees, power lines, a distant skyline, and the car's grille fill the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Sitting on a Car Hood Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia sit on a car hood in this printable coloring page, with his pistol lowered and her arm resting across his shoulder. Lucia wears camouflage trousers and an ankle monitor, while Jason wears a tank top and chain necklace. Palm trees, tall buildings, birds, and a helicopter fill the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Roxy with Curly Hair Sticking Out Her Tongue Coloring Page
pages.description: Roxy sticks out her tongue in this printable coloring page, framed by tight curls, a fluffy coat collar, and necklaces bearing her name. The word Bad appears above one eyebrow, and a small ring sits through her nose. A leopard-patterned zip top shows beneath her layered chains.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason in a Floral Shirt Beside Lucia Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason appears beside Lucia in this printable coloring page, wearing a floral shirt and chain necklace while her arm drapes across his shoulder. Lucia wears hoop earrings and an open jacket, with loose curls framing her face. Her other hand rests on his upper arm in the close portrait.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia with a Paisley Bandana over Her Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia wears a patterned bandana over her nose and mouth in this printable coloring page, with a high ponytail and a large hoop earring. Paisley shapes, leaf motifs, and dotted borders cover the cloth, and a tied knot sits beside her flowing hair. The hood and drawstrings of her sweatshirt frame the bottom of the portrait.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Holding a Paisley Bandana over His Face Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason holds a patterned bandana over his nose and mouth in this printable coloring page, gripping its upper corners with both hands below his eyes. Paisley curls, small diamonds, and dotted borders cover the triangular cloth, while short textured hair and furrowed brows fill the close portrait.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Aiming a Pistol Beside Lucia Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason aims a pistol with both hands in this printable coloring page, wearing an open palm-patterned shirt while Lucia stands behind him holding another pistol. Wooden dock planks lead toward water, with an arched bridge, tall buildings, palm trees, a helicopter, and part of a boat behind them.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia in Sunglasses with Jason Behind Her Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia poses in narrow sunglasses in this printable coloring page, with Jason behind her and his arm across the front of her sleeveless top. She holds his forearm with one hand and places the other on her hip, wearing hoop earrings, bracelets, and a round pendant. Jason wears an open collared shirt and a large wristwatch.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos in a Cropped Tank Top Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos stands in a cropped tank top in this printable coloring page, with hoop earrings, a high ponytail, and her head turned slightly. Her wavy hair falls behind one shoulder, and small beauty marks appear on her cheek and chin. Her belt and wristwatch appear near the bottom of the portrait.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Holding a Curved Magazine Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval holds a curved magazine in this printable coloring page, wearing a Leonida tank top, chain necklace, and a large wristwatch. Wooden roof slats and beams stretch above him, with window blinds behind his shoulders. Bundled banknotes sit beside his camouflage trousers at the bottom.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Holding Guns by the Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia stand beside the waterfront with guns lowered in this printable coloring page, beneath a helicopter casting a long searchlight beam. Jason wears a printed U.S. Army T-shirt and wristwatch, while Lucia wears an open jacket, crop top, and frayed skirt. Boats, waterfront buildings, birds, and a second helicopter complete the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia on a Beach Platform Beside Jason Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia sits with one knee raised on a wooden beach platform in this printable coloring page, with Jason seated in the convertible below. She wears hoop earrings, a tank top, shorts, and lace-up sneakers, while Jason rests an arm on the car door. Beachgoers, palms, a lifeguard tower, distant helicopter, and Ferris wheel line the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Leaning on a Car Door Beside Jason Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia leans her folded arms on a convertible door beside Jason in this printable coloring page, with her long ponytail streaming behind her. Jason wears rectangular sunglasses and a sleeveless shirt as he faces forward in his seat. Hoop earrings, curved balconies, shrubs, and the arch of a bridge add details around the close-up pair.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Holding a Pool Cue Beside a Man Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia stands beside a man at a pool table in this printable coloring page, holding a cue upright with her arm across his shoulder. She wears hoop earrings, an open jacket, a crop top, and lace-up pants. The man wears a printed sleeveless shirt, chain, and digital watch, with a skull tattoo on his upper arm beneath the hanging bulbs.

pages.title: Woman Holding a Cocktail in a Leopard-Print Wrap Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman looks over her shoulder while holding a stemmed cocktail glass in this printable coloring page, wearing hoop earrings and a leopard-print wrap. Her top ties across her back, while the wrap forms a large bow at her hip. A palm trunk, balcony rails, curtains, a tall building, and small figures fill the background.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia in Handcuffs with Two Long Braids Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia stands with her wrists handcuffed in front in this printable coloring page, wearing a prison uniform with her name printed on the pocket. Tight scalp braids lead into two long braids over her shoulders. Brick walls, barred doors, steps, and a seated inmate form the jail corridor behind her.

pages.title: GTA 6 Woman Adjusting Sunglasses with a Drink Coloring Page
pages.description: A woman lifts her sunglasses while holding a drink can in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, wearing a cropped jersey and frayed shorts. Her long curls, hoop earrings, layered necklaces, and star pendant add smaller details. The Grand Theft Auto VI logo, palms, yacht, helicopter, waterfront skyline, and car corner fill the background.

pages.title: Armed Driver and Woman in a Convertible Coloring Page
pages.description: A man steers a convertible while holding a compact gun in this printable coloring page, with a woman raising both arms behind the windshield. She wears a crop top, shorts, and hoop earrings. Flying papers, two helicopters, a parachute, palm trees, city buildings, and other cars fill the surrounding scene.

pages.title: GTA 6 Brian Heder Studying a Map in a Boat Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Brian Heder leans both hands over a map on a workbench in this printable coloring page, wearing a floral shirt with sunglasses on his head. A boat stands behind him beneath roof beams and hanging lights, with a ladder against its side. Shelves, tools, a knife, cartridges, and a labeled bottle surround the work area.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Portrait with Her Hair Pulled Back and Hoop Earrings Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos tilts her chin up in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with her hair swept into a high ponytail and large hoops at her ears. Loose curls frame her face, and the doubled lines around her tank top leave a narrow band to color along the neckline.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Wearing His Backward Baseball Cap and Leonida Tank Top Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval wears his backward baseball cap in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with the snap strap just above his eyebrows. His tank top spells out Leonida beneath a sun and two palm trees, echoing the palms that lean over the water behind him.

pages.title: GTA 6 Cover Art with Jason and Lucia in the Center and a Helicopter in the Upper-Left Panel Coloring Page
pages.description: This GTA 6 cover art printable coloring page pairs Jason and Lucia at the center with a helicopter in a separate panel at the upper left. Palm trees and a tiny skyline fit inside the giant VI above them, and a beach lifeguard tower stands beside the setting sun.

pages.title: GTA 6 Poster of Lucia and Jason Sitting on the Hood of a Classic Car Beneath the Palms Coloring Page
pages.description: In this GTA 6 poster-style printable coloring page, Lucia and Jason sit on the hood of a classic car beneath tall palms. One of Lucia’s lace-up sneakers rests just above the grille, and a Ferris wheel rises over the water beyond Jason’s shoulder.

pages.title: GTA 6 Illustrated Map of Leonida Showing Vice City, the Grassrivers Marshes and the Leonida Keys Coloring Page
pages.description: An illustrated map of Leonida fills this GTA 6 printable coloring page, from the Grassrivers marshes to the Vice City waterfront and the Leonida Keys. An airboat and an alligator share a marsh channel, while a long bridge curves past palm-covered islands near the bottom of the map.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Wearing Bandanas Outside the Xero Gas Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia wear paisley bandanas over their faces in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set outside the Xero gas station. The pointed scarves have small teardrop shapes to color, while the broad canopy behind the pair carries the Xero name above a single visible gas pump.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice City Sign with the Giant VICE Letters on Their Steel Frame Coloring Page
pages.description: The giant VICE letters tower above the shoreline in this GTA 6 printable coloring page of the Vice City sign. Bolts and diagonal braces divide the steel frame into smaller sections, and a low bridge and distant buildings are visible through the gaps beneath the lettering.

pages.title: GTA 6 Trailer 2 Artwork of Lucia Carrying a Metal Case as She and Jason Step Onto the Dock Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia carries a metal case onto the dock in this GTA 6 Trailer 2 printable coloring page, with Jason following one step behind. The case has twin latches and reinforced corners, and a floatplane rests on the water beyond the dock planks and wooden posts.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos in Her Prison Uniform Walking Through Leonida Penitentiary Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos walks through Leonida Penitentiary in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, wearing a short-sleeved prison uniform with a single chest pocket. Two figures walk away along a chain-link fence, and the prison name appears in outlined letters above the barred windows to Lucia’s left.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Wearing a Lace Dress Beneath Her Leopard-Print Coat Coloring Page
pages.description: A leopard-print coat frames Lucia Caminos and her lace dress in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set against a beachfront skyline. Lucia rests both hands at her waist, leaving the large spots on her sleeves and the small flowers along the dress’s scalloped hem in view.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos on Her Motorcycle Beneath the Liquor Bar Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos sits astride her motorcycle in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with both hands on the handlebars beneath the Liquor Bar sign. A round headlamp faces forward between two rearview mirrors, and the sign’s outlined letters provide another area to color above the striped awning.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval's Vapid Ganado Lowrider Pickup with Its Long Hood and Open Truck Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval leans against his Vapid Ganado lowrider pickup in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, arms folded above the truck’s long hood. The grille carries an oval Vapid badge beside the stacked headlights, and the open truck bed sits low beneath the palms along the waterfront.

pages.title: GTA 6 Boobie Ike in Sunglasses and Gold Chains Beneath the Jack of Hearts Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: Boobie Ike wears rectangular sunglasses and two gold chains in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set outside the Jack of Hearts. His initials hang from the longer chain, and the club’s name stretches across the curved sign above his braids, with a heart centered over the lettering.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dre'Quan Priest at the Mixing Desk in the Only Raw Records Studio Coloring Page
pages.description: Dre'Quan Priest works the mixing desk at Only Raw Records in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with one hand on a fader and the other on a knob. A track display sits beside a studio speaker, and a microphone with a round pop filter hangs above the console.

pages.title: GTA 6 Raul Bautista Standing at the Helm of a Yacht with Vice City Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Raul Bautista grips the wheel of a yacht in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with Vice City’s waterfront just beyond the rail. Palm trees line the shore behind him and repeat across his open-collar shirt, where two chains hang above the large buttons.

pages.title: GTA 6 Brian Heder in a Tropical Shirt at His Leonida Keys Boatyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This GTA 6 printable coloring page catches Brian Heder at his Leonida Keys boatyard, with sunglasses on his head and a bottle in his hand. Large hibiscus blooms cover his open shirt, and a motorboat rests on supports beside a shed with a hose coiled on the wall.

pages.title: GTA 6 Ocean View Hotel with Its Art Deco Entrance and Neon Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: The Ocean View Hotel’s neon sign curves around its Art Deco entrance in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with palms framing the stepped facade. Jason and Lucia stand beside a car at the foot of the steps, just below the wide marquee with the hotel’s name in outlined letters.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vapid Stanier '55 Sedan with Its Two-Tone Body and Wide Chrome Grille Coloring Page
pages.description: The Vapid Stanier ’55 faces the viewer at an angle in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, showing off its wide chrome grille and round headlights. A narrow strip of trim divides the two-tone body into long panels, with palm trees and a lifeguard tower along the waterfront behind the sedan.

pages.title: GTA 6 Thrillbilly Mud Club with a Lifted Truck Sending Mud Over Its Wheel Arches Coloring Page
pages.description: A lifted pickup throws mud over its wheel arches on this GTA 6 printable coloring page set at the Thrillbilly Mud Club. The high suspension exposes the front axle and coil springs between the tires, and a wooden sign carries the club’s name in large outlined letters.

pages.title: GTA 6 Grotti Cheetah '95 with Its Pop-Up Headlights Raised Outside Pegassi Residences Coloring Page
pages.description: Both pop-up headlights are raised on the Grotti Cheetah ’95 in this GTA 6 printable coloring page outside Pegassi Residences. The car’s low hood leaves a broad space to color between the lamps, with narrow vents along its side and curved balconies above the building’s entrance.

pages.title: GTA 6 Pegassi Infernus Classic Showing Its Wedge-Shaped Nose and Wide Rear Wing Coloring Page
pages.description: The wedge-shaped nose of the Pegassi Infernus Classic fills the foreground of this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with its wide rear wing visible above the roof. Narrow side vents break up the body panels, and an arched bridge leads across the water toward a skyline of tall buildings.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vapid Dominator Buggy with Its 1967 Fastback Body and Oversized Off-Road Tires Coloring Page
pages.description: The Vapid Dominator Buggy rides high on oversized off-road tires in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with a hood scoop on its 1967 fastback body. Four round lights line the front bumper above a slotted skid plate, and the deep tread blocks stand out against the bare dirt track.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice Beach Police Cruiser with Marked Doors and a Rooftop Light Bar Coloring Page
pages.description: A Vice Beach Police cruiser sits beside the beach in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with a rooftop light bar and bold lettering on its doors. A palm emblem marks the rear door, while a flagged lifeguard tower and a rounded Art Deco building frame the street behind it.

pages.title: GTA 6 Police Cruisers Chasing a Pickup Down a Muddy Grassrivers Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Two Leonida Police cruisers chase a pickup along a muddy Grassrivers trail in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. The passenger points ahead as the truck’s front wheel throws up spray, and just beyond the splashes an alligator peers out of the water near a cluster of lily pads.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dinka Enduro Dirt Bike Parked Outside Jason's Garage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Dinka Enduro dirt bike rests on its kickstand outside Jason’s garage in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Its knobby front tire, spokes and brake disc are all in view, while Jason leans against the doorway with his arms crossed beside shelves holding a toolbox and fuel can.

pages.title: GTA 6 Flock of Flamingos Lifting Off Over the Grassrivers Wetlands Coloring Page
pages.description: Six flamingos take flight over the Grassrivers wetlands in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with one large bird spreading its wings across the center. Its long legs trail just above a splash among the lily pads, and the round propeller cage of an airboat stands out beyond the reeds.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dolphins Surfacing Beside the Squalo Speedboat with Jason and Lucia on Deck Coloring Page
pages.description: Two dolphins surface beside the Squalo speedboat in this GTA 6 printable coloring page featuring Jason and Lucia out on the water. Jason steers while Lucia holds the rail and rests an arm on his shoulder, just above the boat’s sloping bow and the curling splashes around the dolphins.

pages.title: GTA 6 Plane Towing the NINE1NINE Nightclub Banner Along Vice Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: A small propeller plane tows the NINE1NINE nightclub banner along Vice Beach on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. The banner’s big outlined letters stretch across the sky above two beachgoers, with a raised lifeguard tower, a row of umbrellas and waterfront buildings farther down the shore.

pages.title: GTA 6 Bravado Banshee Roadster with a Racing Stripe Running the Length of Its Hood Coloring Page
pages.description: The Bravado Banshee roadster faces the viewer in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, its racing stripe running from the windshield down over the front bumper. Both seats show above the long hood, and the open spokes of the front wheel echo the gaps between the bridge piers in the distance.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia in an Open Convertible with a Yacht and Ferris Wheel Across the Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason takes the wheel and Lucia leans back beside him in an open convertible on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Across the water, a yacht with round portholes sits in front of a Ferris wheel that rises above the palm-lined shore.
